name: ui_actions
description: Get a flat list of actionable UI elements currently on screen. Returns only elements that can be clicked, scrolled, or checked -- optimized for quickly discovering what interactions are available. Each element includes a human-readable label, action type (click/scroll/check), and center coordinates for tapping. Sorted by screen position (top-to-bottom, left-to-right). Use this instead of ui_dump when you just need to know 'what can I interact with?'.

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device connected)
